calibration.overall_assessment: High-confidence predictions (top 10-25%) improved significantly, but this came at catastrophic cost to underdog performance. The +250_plus odds band completely collapsed (47.1% to 22.2% accuracy). Overall model degradation across all broad segments despite narrow top-tier improvements.

key_insights: BASELINE RESTORATION FAILED: Despite reverting monotone_constraints.json to pre-iteration 3 configuration (130 constraints), model did NOT return to expected baseline metrics. Expected ~68% accuracy, got 64.98%.
Overall metrics all degraded: accuracy -3.03%, Brier score +0.0023, AUC -0.0256, log_loss +0.004
High-confidence paradox: Top 10% and top 25% accuracy improved substantially (+3.34% and +5.48%), but broad segments all degraded
Catastrophic underdog collapse: +250_plus odds band imploded from 47.1% accuracy/0.92 ROI to 22.2%/ -0.16 ROI - nearly complete loss of predictive power for heavy underdogs
Underdog ROI decimation: Overall ROI dropped from 0.51 to 0.09 (-82%), with bottom 75% confidence ROI collapsing from 0.33 to 0.03 (-91%)
Model behaves WORSE than iteration 3 despite identical constraint reversion, suggesting irreversible model state changes
Sample size collapse in +250_plus band: only 9 bets vs 17 in baseline, indicating model lost confidence/ability to identify heavy underdog opportunities
Critical finding: Constraint manipulation causes irreversible damage. Adding back constraints at 0 (iteration 4) and full reversion (iteration 5) both failed to restore baseline.
The constraint removal fundamentally altered model behavior in ways that cannot be reversed by simple constraint file restoration
Both favorites and underdogs suffered accuracy declines, eliminating any hoped-for tradeoff between segments
change_summary: Revert to true baseline (pre-iteration 3) by removing 3 features from monotone_constraints.json (num_common_opponents, orthodox_vs_orthodox, southpaw_vs_southpaw), restoring 130 constraints
